personality: 4 Tactile / Playful LIGHT (fused with 6 Glass / Luxe surfaces for premium feel)
personality_one_liner: A warm, premium, and playful connection engine that turns vague intentions into magical real-world plans.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Allow the UI to breathe. Thumb zone sticky CTAs must have safe-area clearance + breathing room.

do's: Use glass on the bottom tab bar and sticky headers.
Use glass on the 'Spark It' bottom sheet handle and header.
Use glass over imagery for floating action buttons or 'Why we picked it' badges on Spark Cards.
dont's: Do not use glass on standard form fields or static body content.
Do not use blur without a tinted minimum opacity backdrop.

screens.name: Welcome
screens.purpose: Introduce the value proposition emotionally and lead into the wizard or login.
screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with vertical 3-stop gradient scrim. 'DATE SPARK ✨' wordmark at top. Value prop centered. Primary 'Create a Spark ✨' (brandPrimary) and Secondary 'Log In' (glass or transparent) buttons sticky at the bottom.

screens.name: Spark Creation Wizard
screens.purpose: Collect Who, Vibe, Budget, Distance in a frictionless, step-by-step flow.

states.loading: Spinner on the CTA while generating sparks
states.error: Toast error 'Please select an option' if trying to proceed empty.

screens.layout: Progress bar at top. Large typography for questions. Use oversized, touchable pills/cards for options. Who (single select), Vibe (multi-select grid), Budget (segmented control or chips), Distance (slider or distinct chips). 'Continue' button sticky at the bottom inside a fixed container.

screens.name: Spark Results Cards

states.loading: Shimmer skeletons shaped like the spark cards.
states.empty: 'We couldn't find the perfect Spark yet.' illustration + 'Expand My Search' CTA.

screens.layout: Horizontal snapping carousel (or stacked Tinder-style cards). Each card takes up 85% of screen height. Real background imagery with heavy gradient scrim at the bottom. Display title, Vibe tags, Distance, and a 'Why we picked it' frosted glass badge. 'View Spark ✨' button on the card.

screens.name: Spark Detail
screens.purpose: Provide the exact itinerary, map, and actionable buttons to commit.

states.loading: Skeleton of the map and timeline.

screens.layout: Top 40% of the screen is a MapView. Bottom 60% is a bottom sheet containing the Itinerary Timeline (vertical dashed line connecting event nodes: 6:00 PM Coffee, 7:00 PM Walk, etc.). Sticky 'Spark It ✨' CTA at the bottom to share/commit, alongside a secondary 'Save' button.

screens.name: Spark It Share Invitation
screens.purpose: A magical, shareable card to invite the other person/people.
screens.layout: A beautifully framed card on a tinted background (using brandTertiary or imagery). Shows the 'I found something for us. ✨' message, the Spark title, and an optional Date/Time picker (Today/Tomorrow/Weekend). Prominent 'Share Spark' CTA to trigger native share sheet.

screens.name: My Sparks
screens.purpose: Archive of Saved, Created, and Completed Sparks.

states.empty: Blank polaroid illustration with 'No sparks here yet. Go create a moment!'

screens.layout: Standard top-tab or segmented control (Saved / Created / Completed). List of horizontal cards with thumbnail image on the left, title and date on the right.

screens.name: Premium Paywall
screens.purpose: Upsell the 'Take Your Spark Further ✨' subscription.
screens.layout: Hero image/abstract gradient background. Value props in a list with checkmarks (e.g., unlimited sparks, advanced filters). Large sticky 'Start Premium' button ($24.99/month, 2-week free trial). Subtle 'Maybe Later' text button below it.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Do NOT use blues or purples anywhere, fallback to surfaceInverse (#2B2524) for dark contrast.
Text on image rule: ALWAYS use a vertical linear-gradient scrim (transparent -> 20% surfaceInverse -> 70% surfaceInverse) between images and text (e.g., Welcome Screen, Spark Cards, Share Invite).
Wizard UI: Keep questions isolated. Decouple inputs to avoid overwhelming the user. Place a sticky 'Continue' CTA bounded to the bottom safe area.
Itinerary View: Use the MapView with an overlaid BottomSheet from @gorhom/bottom-sheet. Inside the sheet, create a vertical timeline UI component with dashed connection lines between stops.
Use Phosphor icons consistently (Filled style) for a playful, tactile feel.
Spark Visual Identity: Use the Spark (✨) prominently in buttons ('Create a Spark ✨') and ensure the brand color (#FF5A36) spotlights primary actions without drowning the UI.
Card Layouts: Ensure lists use space-between and standard gap sizes (md: 12). Cards should NOT sit perfectly flush with the screen edges; maintain consistent lg (16pt) margins.
